game_concept.description: The core concept of Dimensions: every unit is a four-pillar being with stats Vitality (physical), World (spiritual), Matter (emotional) and Will (mental); the pillars are exactly the four stats entries (stat_vitality, stat_world, stat_matter, stat_will) and every element maps to one of them. Species rule: playable races have sum(stats) = 40 (hence 4 life by Rule 14: life = round_half_up(sum / 10)); ordinary objects have 0 Vitality and 0 Will, plants 0 Will, astral/undead 0 Vitality, magical/ethereal beings non-zero World. A Dimension is a tileset of 3x4, 4x4, 5x5 or 8x8 tiles holding face-down trap effects, monsters, class cards, towers, crystals, libraries, nexus, doors, mines and stashes; it is entered by nexus drop, dimension door or a new-game library spawn. Progression is lateral (no levels; character value = non-action cards in the deck); win conditions: arena = defeat opponents, world = control 12 monsters, mmorpg = no single global win. Death returns the character to its tower or replaces it.

prerequisites.description: Every pillar named in the concept has a stats entry stat_<pillar> in the catalog.
